changelog:
v6.3 — harvest of a monorepo adopter's local edits to shared toolkit files, so it can update without losing them.

Fixes: the gate's test-output parser accumulates one summary per package for every runner (vitest, rust, pytest, dotnet) instead of keeping only the last, and a project that collects no tests ("Tests  no tests") or reports unhandled errors outside the pass/fail counts now fails the test leg even when the runner exits 0 (a crashed worker used to hide behind another package's green summary); master-tracker totals count a checklist shared by several epics once, recognize a plain `| Total |` row and prefer an explicit Total over summing phases, keep a carried Done within its plausible maximum, no longer count indented acceptance-criteria bullets or a bold-checkbox body plus its Story Index table twice, skip `_archive` copies in both the glob and fallback scans, and report rows left unchanged; `metrics.js` counts checklists by the same rule; the memory cap check skips parsing files that cannot hold a tombstone and no longer scans a category twice per write; the secret-safe writer ignores the filename-only high-risk finding when redacting content; skill conformance treats a symlinked (vendored) skill's body budget as advisory-unactionable while keeping the hard checks; the organize hook matches any Work Document References table layout and reports on stderr instead of silently dropping the row; the read-output scrubber scans test files for named providers instead of skipping them; the commit-time secret scanner reads NUL-separated paths so a non-ASCII filename no longer blocks every commit; the fleet delivery snapshot ignores dependency trees.

Workflow guidance: run-todo makes code review mandatory for a wave that creates a registry, resolver, shared constant or schema, or is the first to use two reviewed contracts together, and requires a skip to be recorded; sweep closes a review gap named by a retro in the same pass; check-sync re-derives every status or count claim from its primary source before rating it synced.

Migration: none. A tracker whose recorded Done exceeded its total is corrected to the plausible maximum on the next refresh.

--- v6.2 ---
v6.2 — harvest of adopter-local edits to shared toolkit files, so an adopter can update without losing them.

Features: an opt-in `visual` gate leg (full gate only, local only, zero-snapshot runs fail) and TIMED OUT detail in the test-leg summary; a source-code reference allowlist and a TypeScript type-member allowlist for the generic secret-assignment patterns, scoped to source files, judged on the whole line tail, shared by the scanner and the redactor, and never exempting a credential-shaped quoted literal, a comment, a shell string or an opaque run (the read-output scrubber and the secret-safe writer pass the file path to the redactor); runtime-binding references wrapped in inline code are no longer flagged; skill-evolution attribution now uses IDF weighting, a distinct-token gate and a confidence margin, reports near-ties as ambiguous instead of attributing them, and treats an explicit "none attributable to the agents" section as caught; the memory promoter no longer suggests the architecture skill's template scaffold as the target for constraints.

Also: the lint, e2e and visual gate legs get a default timeout when their config omits one, and a killed visual leg is reported as TIMED OUT. Migration: none; IMPROVE scores from skill-evolution intake are IDF-weighted from this version and not comparable with earlier ones.

--- v6.1 ---
v6.1 — upstream baseline refresh: generic runtime improvements, no breaking adopter migration.

Features: model tiers (fast/standard/deep/audit) resolved per runtime from adapter model-tiers.json, with {{model-arg:...}} tokens in workflow, role and startup prose; Codex hook identities (.codex/hook-identities.json), trust-evidence tooling and a SubagentStop hook for completion-sourced dispatch telemetry; generated dispatch-route diagrams for the run-todo workflow (render-shared-agents.js --routes); gate owned-process leases with lock-recovery evidence on Windows and a gate-owned break of abandoned POSIX locks (idle dead-owner, legacy and unreadable) on positive proof of exit; render-ledger uninstall (reviewed, approval-bound) and a read-only context-audit; a publisher personal-path lint that refuses to copy a home path before any write, with a shipped-content lint over the publish selection; workshop focused-test and fast-tier evaluation tooling.

Fixes: broader guardrail rules for clustered force-push flags and remote deletions after Git global options, with additive tag pushes no longer prompting; skill-merger, daily-log and pre-compaction-archive fixes; role and workflow guidance reconciled with the tier model.

Migration: none required. Ordinary install and template-updater --merge keep working with no new argument. New helper paths (codex-hook-identities.js, owned-process-tree.js, build-lock-recovery.js, workflow-routes.js, model-prose.js, context-audit.js, uninstall.js, subagent-stop.cjs) may collide with a same-named adopter file; install refuses an unowned codex-hook-identities.js collision before writing. Native Codex hook registrations change (SubagentStop), so installed hooks need native re-trust.

Runtime limits: Windows Job Object and lease recovery behavior, fresh-session Codex hook execution and trusted native-model runs are not newly established by this release; Windows-bound fast-tier proof tooling is deferred. The Claude audit-fallback environment variable is documented, never applied.
